flexible_post_content.text_editor:
Since launching as a brand communications firm in 2005, a lot has changed, but O3 World’s leadership team has made evolution part of our business model. Now, as a digital product design and development agency, we’re celebrating our 10-year anniversary and forging ahead into the future.

This fall, CEO Keith Scandone sat down with the Philadelphia Daily News to discuss how far we’ve come after a decade in the business, what makes us successful, and what’s coming next. Check out the article online or in the November 16 issue of the paper.
